name: The Component Gallery
description: An index of 60+ real-world design systems and component libraries, cataloging how design systems like Material, Apple, Atlassian, Shopify Polaris, and Gov.uk implement each UI control.

name: Open UI (WICG)
license: W3C Software and Document License / CC0-1.0
description: A collaborative community project by browser vendors and web developers to standardize UI component anatomy, behaviors, and native HTML controls (e.g., `<selectmenu>`, popover API, dialog, tabs).

name: Awesome React Components
description: Exhaustive, community-maintained list of React UI components, libraries, virtual tables, drag-and-drop engines, modal managers, and chart integrations.

name: Awesome Vue (Components & Libraries)
description: Official community-curated list of Vue component libraries, form validators, UI toolkits, and table components for Vue 3.

name: Awesome Svelte (Component Libraries)
description: Curated collection of Svelte component libraries (Skeleton UI, Flowbite Svelte, Shadcn Svelte, Svelte Material UI).

name: Awesome Web Components
description: Curated guide and catalog of modern Web Components (Custom Elements, Shadow DOM, HTML Templates), interoperable across any frontend framework.

name: Design Systems Repo
description: Frequently updated collection of enterprise design systems, style guides, Figma files, and UI documentation from companies like GitHub, Uber, Audi, and Shopify.
